name: Double-Leg Stretch
description: Hug both knees in with your head curled up, then reach your arms overhead and your legs away at the same time, and circle back in.

source.title: Double Leg Stretch on the Mat (Online Pilates Classes)
source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back, curl your head and shoulders up and hug your knees.
cues: Reach long in both directions without lowering your head.
Keep your lower back on the mat.
Breathe in as you reach, out as you hug.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Hug your knees
keyframes.cue: Knees in, hands on your shins.

keyframes.name: Reach out
keyframes.cue: Arms overhead, legs out to about 45°.
